text:
下列成語用字，何者有誤？
(A)相去咫尺   (B)千鈞一髮        (C)罪無可患         (D)煮豆燃萁

「齧雪吞氈」一詞係指漢朝何人被匈奴單于囚禁於大窖中，不供應飲食，乃嚼雪混同氈毛而吞食？
(A)李廣     (B)張騫     (C)韓信      (D)蘇武

陶淵明〈桃花源記〉： 「晉太元中，武陵人，捕魚為業，『 』溪行，忘路之遠近」 ，其中『 』之 字，下列何者正確？
(A)緣       (B)沿    (C)循       (D)順

左丘明〈燭之武退秦師〉一文，燭之武說服秦君退師的說詞中，最有影響力的選項是？
(A)若亡鄭而有益於君，敢以煩執事
(B)焉用亡鄭以陪鄰？鄰之厚，君之薄也
(C)舍鄭以為東道主，行李之往來，共其乏困，君亦無所害
(D)微夫人之力不及此

荀子〈勸學〉： 「吾嘗終日而思矣，不如須臾之所學也」說明什麼道理？
(A)多思少學     (B)學思並重  (C)思重於學   (D)學重於思

諸葛亮〈出師表〉原文中，下列字詞何者有誤？
(A)中道崩殂   (B)陟罰臧否  (C)咨取善道               (D)裨補闕漏

中國四大名著係指四部古典章回小說，下列何者有誤？
(A)〈儒林外史〉 (B)〈西遊記〉 (C)〈水滸傳〉              (D)〈三國演義〉

下列作品、作者對應，何者有誤？
(A)〈鶯鶯傳〉／杜光庭             (B)〈三國演義〉／羅貫中
(C)〈聊齋誌異〉／蒲松齡            (D)〈世說新語〉／劉義慶 共同科目(國文、英文)   第 1 頁，共 4 頁         【請翻頁繼續作答】

蘇軾〈念奴嬌〉 ：「亂石崩雲，驚濤裂岸，卷起千堆雪。」文中「雪」指什麼？
(A)亂石     (B)浪花    (C)雪花     (D)浮雲

〈岳陽樓記〉一文中說道：「而或長煙一空，皓月千里，浮光躍金，靜影沉璧。」是在描寫 洞庭湖何時的景色？
(A)晴朗的白天  (B)晴朗的夜晚 (C)陰雨的白天 (D)陰雨的夜晚

方孝孺〈指喻〉一文的主旨：「天下之事，常發於至微，而終為大患；始以為不足治，而終 至於不可為。」作者在說明什麼道理？
(A)水到渠成   (B)每下愈況  (C)防微杜漸  (D)指日可待

有關曹雪芹和〈紅樓夢〉敘述，下列何者有誤？
(A)曹雪芹祖先曾任江寧織造，家世顯赫
(B)曹雪芹祖父曹寅為著名的藏書家，並主持〈四庫全書〉的刻印
(C)〈紅樓夢〉初名〈石頭記〉，又名〈風月寶鑑〉 、〈金陵十二釵〉等
(D)〈紅樓夢〉以富貴公子賈寶玉為視角，描繪了人生百態，展現人性美和悲劇美

有關作家黃春明的敘述，下列何者有誤？
(A)一生漢詩創作不輟，有「臺灣新文學之父」之譽
(B)出生宜蘭，作品擅長描寫宜蘭平原農村小人物
(C)語言質樸親切，臺灣當代重要的鄉土文學
(D)小說作品有〈鑼〉、〈兒子的大玩偶〉等

〈桃花源記〉：「遂與外人間隔。問今是何世？乃不知有漢，無論魏、晉！」此句意與下列何 者相同？
(A)浮雲遊子意，落日故人情      (B)天生我材必有用，千金散盡還復來
(C)樹欲靜而風不止，子欲養而親不待  (D)山中無甲子，寒盡不知年

顧炎武〈與友人書〉 ： 「人之為學，不日進則日退。」可作為下列何種學習情況的註腳？
(A)君子慎其所立           (B)君子過目不忘
(C)君子曰：
「學不可以已。」      (D)君子學而不思則罔 貳、英文：100 % 【單選題：40 題，每題 2.5 分，共 100 分；請在『答案卡』題號 16~55 畫記作答。】

It’s not a surprising fact that education levels are _____ related to income.
(A) deeply                (B) heavily              (C) largely             (D) strongly

The deadline was announced. The manager made us _____ our project proposal by next Monday.
(A) submit            (B) to submit        (C) submitting         (D) to be submitted

Today’s news included the results of a study by Veterans General Hospital on the rise in alcoholism _____ the country.
(A) over              (B) cover                (C) across           (D) cross

Many smartphone manufacturers are developing user-friendly mobile devices with many features for a different _____ of the local market.
(A) sector               (B) section       (C) segment             (D) intersection

As the meeting is going to end in 15 minutes, the chairperson suggests we _____ the details and get to the last item on the agenda.
(A) go over              (B) skip over          (C) hop over            (D) move over

The HR manager _____ back from his business trip when we have our meeting next Monday.
(A) is coming       (B) is going to come (C) will have come       (D) has come 共同科目(國文、英文)               第 2 頁，共 4 頁

You should _____ me to change lanes so that I could turn left at the intersection.
(A) allow             (B) let                  (C) have allowed          (D) have let

The representatives of two labor unions haven’t reached a consensus and _____ a solution after months of negotiation.
(A) come by             (B) come up with        (C) come forth         (D) come down with

_____ other forms of energy, the cost of producing solar energy is relatively economical.
(A) Unlike             (B) Dislike             (C) Alike                 (D) Not like

“What do you do for a living?” Choose the best response.
(A) I live just a few blocks from here.
(B) I enjoy living here.
(C) I used to work for an international trading company.
(D) I’m a computer programmer in an IT company.

Some people think that using English is a way of _____ communication, so that people don’t have to negotiate which language they are going to use.
(A) changing           (B) discussing           (C) neutralizing   (D) understanding

A lot of research shows that health problems _____ poor diet and a relative lack of exercise.
(A) are linked to       (B) link with          (C) are linked with      (D) link to

Too much sun damages the skin, _____ many people still do not use sunscreen.
(A) since            (B) and               (C) or                    (D) yet

All new employees enroll in an intensive English program designed to _____ the amount of time they are exposed to spoken English.
(A) change             (B) broaden             (C) maximize           (D) reduce

The team _____ all the best players you can find in this country.
(A) is made of         (B) is composed of      (C) is consisted of       (D) composes of

Dian is so pleased to be informed of an opening in Taipei’s branch since she has been thinking of _____ for a while.
(A) to transfer           (B) to be transferred (C) transferring          (D) being transferred

“Susan is all dressed up. I’d say she’s fishing for compliments.” What does the speaker think about Susan?
(A) Fishing is her favorite activity.            (B) She looks pretty.
(C) She deserves compliments.                    (D) She wants to be praised.

“Everyone, we’re just pulling in to our stop at Austin. We’ll be here for ten minutes to take on some more passengers.” Where is the speaker?
(A) At a store.        (B) On a bus.            (C) On a boat.          (D) On a plane.

Since the files are regarded as strictly _____, you should save them with a password.
(A) confide              (B) confident            (C) confidential       (D) confidence

Interestingly, the painting on the wall is _____ upside down in that restaurant.
(A) hung                  (B) hanged              (C) hang                (D) to hang

Any attempt to influence the referees during the game will be regarded as a(n) _____ of the rules.
(A) fraction           (B) infraction           (C) intrusion          (D) malfunction

The newly-appointed CEO is known not only for her integrity _____ for her decisiveness.
(A) or               (B) but also           (C) nor                 (D) and

Don’t be troubled by Kate’s frequent angry remarks. It’s just _____ of her illness.
(A) a clarification    (B) a consistency      (C) an enforcement        (D) a manifestation

Everyone can be creative. Creativity is a tool we can all equip ourselves with and _____.
(A) futile             (B) utilize              (C) possession           (D) take advantage 共同科目(國文、英文)               第 3 頁，共 4 頁                        【請翻頁繼續作答】

“Believe it or not, Fred’s new novel has been selling like hot cakes.” Choose the best explanation for the sentence.
(A) Fred likes to bake cakes.                   (B) Fred’s novel is about baking cakes.
(C) Fred has been selling cakes.                (D) Fred’s new novel sells well.

Marc Chagall’s masterpieces are currently _____ at the national museum.
(A) on screen         (B) in display          (C) on exhibit         (D) in exhibition

The best way to protect the skin _____ is to avoid the sun when it is at its hottest or wear sunscreen.
(A) to injure          (B) to be injured       (C) from injuring        (D) from being injured

Being a good listener involves more than just the ability to speak. Your body language also _____.
(A) counts              (B) accounts            (C) calculates           (D) depends

General Motors announced yesterday that sales of its vehicles have increased _____ five percent over the last two years.
(A) for              (B) to                   (C) with                 (D) by

The success of our ad campaign for the new products _____ our expectation.
(A) accumulated         (B) exceeded          (C) overwhelmed        (D) procured

According to a recent survey, the amount of time _____ to leisure is dropping.
(A) devoted             (B) sacrificed         (C) taken                (D) spent

Audrey Hepburn will always be the favorite film actress of all time and a(n) _____ to style, elegance, and humanitarianism.
(A) idol              (B) icon                (C) figure               (D) signal

Pop art, _____ developed in the late 1950’s, is the 20th century art movement.
(A) it                 (B) that                  (C) X                  (D) which

Only after I had arrived at the office _____ that I had forgotten to take the office keys with me.
(A) did I realize        (B) I realized           (C) have I realized      (D) I had realized

_____, I think the conference has been a great success.
(A) One for all         (B) One in all          (C) All for all           (D) All in all

Long exposure to second-hand smoke can be _____ to anyone, particularly those who have never smoked before.
(A) detrimental      (B) meticulous       (C) incremental        (D) sentimental

The company has _____ telemarketing as an effective means of seeking potential customers for years.
(A) found            (B) adopted             (C) hired              (D) understood

The government has decided to _____ the ban on the import of US beef until the end of next year.
(A) extend            (B) expand             (C) launch             (D) release

All staff are required to _____ these new safety regulations.
(A) comply with           (B) abide with         (C) conform with         (D) obey with

“Who’s going to fill the position of Mike Andrews?” Choose the best response.
(A) He should fill out the form first.
(B) He wants a higher position.
(C) They’re considering an intern from the Marketing Department.
(D) He went to the Accounting Department. 共同科目(國文、英文)               第 4 頁，共 4 頁
